title: Host-wide content-addressed store / Rechnerweiter inhaltsadressierter Speicher
$comment: 🗄️ CasPolicyV1: one store per host, shared and deduplicated by all workspaces, size-capped with least-recently-accessed eviction. Byte sizes are plain numbers; ratios are fractions of capBytes.

progress.en: Cache store: scanned {entries} entries, {usedGib} GiB used of {capGib} GiB, freed {freedMib} MiB.
progress.de: Cache-Speicher: {entries} Einträge geprüft, {usedGib} GiB belegt von {capGib} GiB, {freedMib} MiB freigegeben.

done.en: Cache store collected: {evicted} entries, {freedMib} MiB freed, {keptGib} GiB kept, {protectedMib} MiB protected{partial}.
done.de: Cache-Speicher bereinigt: {evicted} Einträge, {freedMib} MiB freigegeben, {keptGib} GiB behalten, {protectedMib} MiB geschützt{partial}.

idle.en: Cache store is below the high watermark ({usedGib} GiB of {capGib} GiB); nothing to collect.
idle.de: Der Cache-Speicher liegt unter der oberen Marke ({usedGib} GiB von {capGib} GiB); nichts zu bereinigen.

locked.en: Another collector already runs on this cache store.
locked.de: Auf diesem Cache-Speicher läuft bereits ein Sammler.

shortfall.en: The store stays above its cap by {overMib} MiB because the rest is pinned, leased or too young.
shortfall.de: Der Speicher bleibt um {overMib} MiB über der Grenze, weil der Rest gepinnt, geleast oder zu jung ist.

status.en: Cache store {root}: {objects} objects, {usedGib} GiB of {capGib} GiB cap.
status.de: Cache-Speicher {root}: {objects} Objekte, {usedGib} GiB von {capGib} GiB Grenze.

adopted.en: Cache store: {linked} files now share {objects} stored objects, {savedMib} MiB saved, {failed} failed{partial}.
adopted.de: Cache-Speicher: {linked} Dateien teilen sich jetzt {objects} gespeicherte Objekte, {savedMib} MiB gespart, {failed} fehlgeschlagen{partial}.

adopting.en: Cache store: examined {entries} files, {savedMib} MiB saved so far.
adopting.de: Cache-Speicher: {entries} Dateien geprüft, bisher {savedMib} MiB gespart.

places.reason: The bun content cache never changes a stored file in place.
Pinned tool archives are written once under their digest.
The Bazel disk cache CAS names every file by its digest and replaces, never edits, it.
Installed trees can be patched or rewritten by their tools, so only copy-on-write clones are safe.
Installed toolchains can be updated in place by their tools, so only copy-on-write clones are safe.
